about: William Hannosh is a top-rated attorney who practices law in San Diego, California. William Hannosh focuses on Family Law issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Civil Litigation: Plaintiff, Civil Litigation: Defense, Elder Law and General Litigation.

William Hannosh received Super Lawyers designation for 2024 - 2025. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 2007. Before practicing law, he attended law school at Thomas Jefferson School of Law and graduated in 2001.
